question.text: Short-term capital gain on listed equity shares (holding ≤12 months, STT paid) for Cat III AIF is taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 111A and Table 9.1, STCG on listed equity with STT paid = 20% (post-July 2024). Previously 15%. The Trap: 15% was pre-July 2024; 10%/30% are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Recent change under Finance Act 2024. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Update client calculators from 15% to 20% for STCG STT-paid.
